_about: Settings for src/pipelines/enrich_corner_assignments.py. Command-line flags override them.
_alias_requires_spoken_reference: An alias places a note only when the note itself refers to the corner by that name (its spoken_as) and the name is said in the transcript. Speakers use named corners as reference points for their neighbours ('after Cunningham'), which misplaced 7 of 16 hidden notes without this.
_calibrate: Each run hides every third explicit note, enriches, and measures how often each method puts it back on the right corner. A method's confidence is then capped at that accuracy ((correct + 1) / (placed + 2)) when it was tried at least calibration_min_samples times. Calibration can only lower a confidence.

locate._about: How a note is found back in its transcript. A whole note must share min_note_share of its words with 3 transcript lines; failing that, single fields of at least min_field_words words must share min_field_share with 3 lines, and the located fields must lie within max_field_spread_seconds of each other.
